**December 1, 2026 is still the target, but it isn’t guaranteed.** As of November 17, Fernhill’s identity-provider-initiated login worked on staging, but login started from Kestrel was blocked by the bank’s SHA-1 signing configuration. Kestrel requires SHA-256 or stronger and has ruled out a temporary SHA-1 exception [2][12].

What remains:

- Fernhill’s change board must approve the switch to SHA-256 on November 24; Helen says it would be applied that evening if approved [1].
- The teams need to complete the joint end-to-end test scheduled for November 25 at 14:00 London time. Priya had made that week’s test a condition for the launch date [1].
- The SSO admin page is on staging, though its copy still needs Priya’s review [2].

If the board does not approve the change, Sam will tell Fernhill on November 24 that December 1 is at risk [12]. The planned launch includes automatic user creation with a Viewer role; SCIM deprovisioning is not in the December scope [2].
